items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: Johnny Bugs, he used to work for Fats Waller, Johnny Hamilton, yeah, we worked together out in North and South Road, you know. That's when I first met him.

ctx.x: Oh, yeah, this is you know and it's for free. It's the damnedest thing I ever heard in the world, it's for free but it certainly was. But, we did. So they did digged it. So I would go down and listen to the guys. So a fellow by the name of Crock Stanley Stanley of Walter (Scratch) Sandy, always think about him, you know. I was just thinking about him today.
